name: bucket
description: (Optional, Forces new resource) The name of the bucket. If omitted, Terraform will assign a random, unique name.

name: cors_rule
description: List of maps containing rules for Cross-Origin Resource Sharing.

name: restrict_public_buckets
description: Whether Amazon S3 should restrict public bucket policies for this bucket.

name: object_ownership
description: Object ownership. Valid values: BucketOwnerPreferred or ObjectWriter. 'BucketOwnerPreferred': Objects uploaded to the bucket change ownership to the bucket owner if the objects are uploaded with the bucket-owner-full-control canned ACL. 'ObjectWriter': The uploading account will own the object if the object is uploaded with the bucket-owner-full-control canned ACL.

name: attach_policy
description: Controls if S3 bucket should have bucket policy attached (set to `true` to use value of `policy` as bucket policy)

name: attach_public_policy
description: Controls if a user defined public bucket policy will be attached (set to `false` to allow upstream to apply defaults to the bucket)

name: bucket_prefix
description: (Optional, Forces new resource) Creates a unique bucket name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with bucket.

name: block_public_acls
description: Whether Amazon S3 should block public ACLs for this bucket.

name: ignore_public_acls
description: Whether Amazon S3 should ignore public ACLs for this bucket.

name: versioning
description: Map containing versioning configuration.

name: attach_elb_log_delivery_policy
description: Controls if S3 bucket should have ELB log delivery policy attached

name: attach_lb_log_delivery_policy
description: Controls if S3 bucket should have ALB/NLB log delivery policy attached

name: attach_deny_insecure_transport_policy
description: Controls if S3 bucket should have deny non-SSL transport policy attached

name: acl
description: (Optional) The canned ACL to apply. Defaults to 'private'. Conflicts with `grant`

name: server_side_encryption_configuration
description: Map containing server-side encryption configuration.

name: tags
description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the bucket.

name: website
description: Map containing static web-site hosting or redirect configuration.

name: grant
description: An ACL policy grant. Conflicts with `acl`

name: lifecycle_rule
description: List of maps containing configuration of object lifecycle management.

name: acceleration_status
description: (Optional) Sets the accelerate configuration of an existing bucket. Can be Enabled or Suspended.

name: request_payer
description: (Optional) Specifies who should bear the cost of Amazon S3 data transfer. Can be either BucketOwner or Requester. By default, the owner of the S3 bucket would incur the costs of any data transfer. See Requester Pays Buckets developer guide for more information.

name: logging
description: Map containing access bucket logging configuration.

name: replication_configuration
description: Map containing cross-region replication configuration.

name: control_object_ownership
description: Whether to manage S3 Bucket Ownership Controls on this bucket.

name: create_bucket
description: Controls if S3 bucket should be created

name: policy
description: (Optional) A valid bucket policy JSON document. Note that if the policy document is not specific enough (but still valid), Terraform may view the policy as constantly changing in a terraform plan. In this case, please make sure you use the verbose/specific version of the policy. For more information about building AWS IAM policy documents with Terraform, see the AWS IAM Policy Document Guide.

name: force_destroy
description: (Optional, Default:false ) A boolean that indicates all objects should be deleted from the bucket so that the bucket can be destroyed without error. These objects are not recoverable.

name: object_lock_configuration
description: Map containing S3 object locking configuration.

name: block_public_policy
description: Whether Amazon S3 should block public bucket policies for this bucket.
